report.explanation: Current evidence shows a healthy gateway: checkout span OK at 60ms, error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters. No downstream service telemetry is available, so no public cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration) is substantiated. Insufficient evidence to assign a root cause; handing off for downstream telemetry.
missing_evidence: Traces/spans for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis to locate any failing or slow hop
Per-service error rates and p95 latency for downstream services
Logs or error details for the checkout path during the alert window
Baseline comparison to confirm whether gateway p95 72ms and error_rate 0.001 are anomalous
